Danforth Park Public School (fictional)
October 5, 2026
Dear Parent or Guardian,
Parent-teacher interviews will be held on Thursday, October 22, 2026 from 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. Interviews are 10 minutes long.
Please return the slip below with your preferred time by Friday, October 16, 2026. If you would like an interpreter, check the box and write the language, and we will do our best to arrange one.
